LanguageData.RK_BFR_Ammo_DescToHE: Switch to high-explosive rounds. The round can detonate in a wide cone when it gets close to targets, which helps against tight groups.
LanguageData.RK_BFR_Ammo_DescToAP: Switch to armor-piercing rounds. The bolt can punch through several targets in a line with strong stab damage.
LanguageData.RK_PulseRifleFireMode_DescToSingle: Switch to single fire. Fires two heavy energy bolts with longer range and better accuracy at medium and long range.
LanguageData.RK_PulseRifleFireMode_DescToBurst: Switch to burst fire. Fires four lighter bolts in quick succession at shorter effective range, suited to close and mid-range fights.
